verdict.rationale: Postmark documents real-time webhooks, with dedicated Delivery and Bounce webhook pages, a webhooks overview on protecting endpoints (basic auth, IP allowlisting), and a TypeScript guide covering payload validation and idempotency. That covers the delivered and bounced outcomes. The evidence pack never mentions a spam-complaint webhook or any documented retry or redelivery schedule, both of which the story asks for. Missing for 10: evidence of a spam complaint webhook, documented webhook retry behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
